name: The Obtrar'ri
startIntroPart1: The Obtrar'ri were descendants of the Lonyriths, born with greater pride and ambition. Together with the Red Elves, they conquered countless kingdoms and asserted their dominance over more than half of the Earth. Their fall marked the end of the Age of Demons, after which they were cast into the Netherworld.
startIntroPart2: Azgaroth the Conqueror, your people wish for an empire of their own once more and require a leader of unparalleled greatness! Will you accept the challenge? Can you build a civilization that will stand the test of time?

attacked: You will face the wrath of the Obtrar'ri!

defeated: Curses! This is not the end! Azgaroth will back! The Obtrar'ri will back! Mark my words.
